correction: An unfiltered /leagues call returns 20 rows and that is a DEFAULT PAGE, not the catalogue. Concluding from it that GameForecast has no national-team coverage was wrong. A name-targeted query - the path resolve_league() itself uses - returns national-team competitions.

name_targeted_probe.meaning: GameForecast DOES cover national-team competitions. Coverage must be established per competition by name, not by reading the unfiltered listing.

note: No credential appears in any reply; the key is a request header.
unknown: Whether GameForecast covers the other national-team competitions (World Cup and its qualifiers, EURO qualification, AFCON, Copa America, Gold Cup, Asian Cup, friendlies) is NOT established: each needs its own name-targeted request and the daily allowance of 8 was exhausted on 2026-09-23. It resets at UTC midnight.
